points.manual: To be born again means to be born from above (heaven). Greek: gennao anothen.

puzzles.blank: born again / from above (final wording set at build from KJV)

points.manual: Born of water and the Spirit. Water is the word of God; the Spirit is the Spirit.
Implications: we can appreciate spiritual things; we are citizens of the Kingdom of God; we need the Word daily to grow; our spirit is joined to God's Spirit and we have God's DNA in us.
How to be born again: agree you are a sinner; believe and confess the Lordship of Jesus Christ.

puzzles.clue: What we confess about Jesus Christ

points.manual: Benefits of being born again, including: a new creature; dead to sin and alive to God; legitimate children of God; access to God's promises; eternal life, the very life of God; the hope of resurrection.

puzzles.task: Find where Jn 1:13 lists three things we are 'not born of'.

points.manual: Misconceptions: it is not water baptism; not speaking in tongues; not being sinless; not being born in a church; not befriending a man of God; not going to church on Sundays.

true: Believing and confessing Jesus as Lord

worlds.name: The Holy Spirit
worlds.motif: wind, kites, leaves in the air

points.manual: The Holy Spirit is Jesus in us. 'Another Comforter' is allos parakletos: allos means one of the same kind; heteros means another which is different. He never leaves us. He is the Spirit of truth who guides us into all spiritual realities.
Fellowship (Greek: koinonia): association, community, joint participation, intimacy.
In fellowship we discover Him as Comforter, Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, Strengthener and Standby.

Seven-fold manifestation: Lord (dominion), Wisdom (counsel to overcome obstacles), Understanding (hope, inheritance, power), Counsel (direction), Might (extraordinary strength), Knowledge (revelation), Fear of the Lord (order, discipline, reverence).

pairs: Counsel from God's mind to overcome obstacles
Knowing the hope, inheritance and power

points.manual: Speaking in tongues: your spirit prays by the Holy Spirit's inspiration; you speak directly and privately to God; the Spirit gives utterance but you must speak yourself.
points.note: The manual's 'Practical: lead the new convert to speak in tongues' is a pastor action, not a game task.

points.manual: Righteousness is God's inability to sit by and watch man perish. Sin has the consequence of death; God gave Jesus as the payment for sin.

puzzles.task: Follow the chain: sin's consequence (Rom 6:23), who it applies to (Rom 5:12), God's payment (Jn 3:16).

points.manual: Righteousness is a free gift: absolute (righteous or sinner), not obtained by doing the law, free but not cheap, and Christ is the gift who becomes our righteousness.

false: You can have a little righteousness
true: Absolute: you either have it or you don't

puzzles.clue: The free gift of right standing

points.manual: Right standing with God: confidence to stand before God; not more or less; we are as right as Jesus is; access because we believe and are united with Him; peace with God and unlimited access.

puzzles.blank: made the righteousness of God in him

points.manual: Dominion over the devil: confidence that the devil is under our feet; authority to cast out devils; power to destroy the devil's works.

pairs: The devil is under our feet
Power to destroy the devil's works

points.manual: Sin is the nature of the devil, passed to Adam and all his descendants. A blood offering was needed; Jesus offered His blood not to cover sin but to remove sin.
At new birth there is the death of the old man (the sinner) and the birth of the new man with the nature of God. The seed of God remains in him.

puzzles.clue: What is changed at new birth

points.manual: Two kinds of sin: sin unto death (not receiving Jesus as Lord and saviour; a nature; what makes a person a sinner) and sin not unto death (acts of sin that may beset a believer; does not make them a sinner).

pairs: Acts of sin; does not make a believer a sinner

puzzles.task: Compare 1 Jn 5:16-17 and Jn 3:16-18. What is the sin unto death?

points.manual: If you commit acts of sin: God does not condemn you, He has already forgiven you; confess it (admit it was wrong, a reason to repent, a clear conscience and fresh start); do not lash out at another believer who sins.

puzzles.scenario: You slip up and feel ashamed.
steps: Know God has already forgiven you
Repent and take a fresh start
puzzles.reflection: What does it mean to you that God does not keep a record?

puzzles.clue: A step after an act of sin (1 Jn 1:9)

points.manual: Soul winning is the art and passion of getting a person born again and nurturing them to express the life of God through prayer, the teaching of God's word and the local assembly. Evangelism begins the process.

puzzles.clue: The process of getting a person born again

points.manual: Elements of growth: food, water, exercise, rest. Spiritual education: venue the church, teacher the pastor, syllabus the Bible.
points.gardenLink: Growth Garden care actions: food, water, exercise, rest. Verses are 'remembered' not 'played'.

points.manual: Importance of soul winning, including: it is the Father's heartbeat; angels cannot win souls; someone has to tell the good news; we were born to win souls; souls cannot win themselves; salvation is already purchased for all.

puzzles.task: Who did God send to Cornelius, and who needed to tell him the good news? (Acts 10)

pairs: Someone has to tell the good news

points.manual: Everyday opportunities: bus, tro-tro, taxi, queues, workplace, lunch break, hostel, roommate, using 'there are 2 kinds of...'.

puzzles.scenario: You are sitting next to someone on a tro-tro.
puzzles.reflection: Who is one person you could talk to this week?

points.note: Wording of the 'two kinds of' opener needs church input.

points.manual: Your role as a church member: attend services faithfully; be a stable member; make your talents and gifts available; know, respect, believe in, listen to, love and pray for your pastors; bear fruits in Christ. Church commitment results in spiritual growth.
Growth through fellowshipping: go to church regularly; join a smaller cell group; be close to other Christians. Jesus and the early Christians were regular church goers.

puzzles.task: Find two early-church verses that show regular gathering.

points.manual: Grow by following: copying, imitating, cloning, reproduction, becoming a double, catching up to the person's level.

puzzles.blank: followers of me, even as I also am of Christ

points.note: Pastor-specific media lists (podcasts, videos) left out of puzzles; church may add as a 'Resources' card.

points.manual: Grow by responding to God's Word: take notes in church; speak in tongues; celebrate the Word; search the scriptures after church.

Grow by joining a department: you have a contribution only you can make; you express the wisdom of God uniquely; it builds you up; training happens there; departments may mentor skills such as graphic design and photography.

puzzles.scenario: You have a gift (music, writing, design, cleaning, service).
steps: Notice what you are good at
puzzles.reflection: What gift could you bring to the house of God?
